verdict.rationale: The Gateway says every call is "credential-managed" (glama-docs-28), and the browser inspector supports OAuth 2.1 when testing servers (glama-docs-12). That hints at some credential handling for downstream MCP tools. Nothing shows the platform running and storing OAuth flows for those tools on the developer's behalf. Missing for 10: documented platform-run OAuth flows for downstream tools, encrypted credential vaulting, automatic token refresh, in-depth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
